_comment: Official reference transcripts for SenseVoice test_wavs. Ground truth for tests/benchmark.js and transcribe.js --check. setup/download-model.js writes these into <model>/test_wavs/*.txt, because the release tarball ships the .wav files but NOT the .txt files.
